# Alaska Team Hosts Historic USS Ted Stevens Commissioning


Oct 6, 2026


Share


When a fire in Whittier, Alaska destroyed the very dock where the U.S. Navy planned to commission its newest guided-missile destroyer, the USS Ted Stevens, the Holland America Princess Alaska team stepped in to help keep the historic event on course.


Working alongside the U.S. Navy, the Holland America Princess transportation and port operations teams quickly relocated the ceremony to the Princess dock in Whittier, just 1.5 miles away.


Working around the clock and in just a matter of weeks, the team successfully scaled operations to meet the event’s extensive security, site-control and capacity requirements. On Oct. 5, thousands of Alaskans joined Navy leaders, elected officials, the Stevens family and the ship’s 350-member crew to celebrate the commissioning.


The team’s swift action earned public recognition from Sen. Lisa Murkowski during the ceremony and ensured an important moment in Alaska and U.S. Navy history could move forward without missing a beat.
